_about: T-210 batch 6 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-03 goal loop): the last batch before the 13 legendaries, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.8 for CONTENT, 2.9 for the rest). Three pairs are two halves of one idea: PLUSLE and MINUN (ANODE, CATHODE), SOLROCK and LUNATONE (BIGENDIAN, LILENDIAN: the same bytes read two ways), and the sworn rivals ZANGOOSE and SEVIPER (PRISTINE, FORGERY).

daemons.name: GLIDEPATH
content: It drops from the cliff and glides down
on a line it worked out before it
jumped. It always lands.
context: It never flies up. It only ever comes
down, and always where it meant to.

daemons.name: POSTULATE
content: It plants its feet and will not be moved.
Everything it does starts from there.
context: Nobody ever proved it should stand
there. It simply does, and so it holds.

daemons.name: DEDUCTION
content: It pushes one step at a time, every
step following from the last, until
there is nowhere left for you to stand.
context: Once it has finished, nobody can
argue. They can only check the steps.

daemons.name: BACKDOOR
content: It lives deep under everything, out of
sight, with eyes that shine in the
dark. It takes what it wants quietly.
context: Look straight at it and it is not
there. It was there all along.

daemons.name: HONEYTRAP
content: It lies still with its mouth open and
something sweet inside. Whatever comes
to take it does not leave.
context: It looks like the easiest way in.
That is the point of it.

daemons.name: BOOTROM
content: It is very small and very hard. It
starts the same way every single time,
and nothing can change how.
context: Everything else begins after it does.
Nothing begins without it.

daemons.name: FIRMWARE
content: Its armour has grown into its body.
It can be changed, just, but almost
nobody ever dares.
context: It was meant to be updated. It has
not been, and it still works.

daemons.name: BIGIRON
content: It is enormous and very old, and its
armour has never once been broken.
Whole towns still run on it.
context: Everyone says it will be replaced
soon. They have said so for years.

daemons.name: CRACKLE
content: Its fur crackles as it runs and stands
on end. Touch it and you will feel
it before you hear it.
context: It means nothing yet. It is only
charge, waiting for somewhere to go.

daemons.name: ARCFLASH
content: Charge builds in its mane until it
jumps the gap all at once in a white
arc. It strikes before the thunder.
context: Where it struck, the air smells
burnt for hours afterward.

daemons.name: ANODE
content: It gives off charge all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
context: On its own it does nothing. With
the other, the current flows.

daemons.name: CATHODE
content: It draws charge in all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
context: It is not the lesser one. Nothing
flows without both of them.

daemons.name: SLOWBURN
content: It burns low and steady inside its
shell for years, and gives off more
smoke than anyone would like.
context: It never quite goes out. Everything
near it ends up a little grey.

daemons.name: HASHCODE
content: Its spots are worked out from
everything it is. Change it at all and
the spots come out completely different.
context: No two have ever had the same spots.
That is how they tell each other apart.

daemons.name: FEWSHOT
content: It learns from almost nothing: one
rain a year is enough. It keeps every
drop it is given.
context: Give it a little and it does well.
Give it a lot and it does not need it.

daemons.name: ZEROSHOT
content: It does things nobody ever showed it,
at night, and it does them well.
Nobody can say where it learned.
context: It was never taught this. It is very
sure of it anyway.

daemons.name: PRISTINE
content: It is exactly what it is, with nothing
added and nothing missing. It can
tell a copy at a glance.
context: It has one enemy, and it would know
that enemy anywhere.

daemons.name: FORGERY
content: It copies whatever it sees, very well,
with one small change hidden inside.
Its tail is its signature.
context: It has one enemy, and it cannot
fool that one at all.

daemons.name: LILENDIAN
content: It reads everything from the small end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
context: Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. Neither is wrong.

daemons.name: BIGENDIAN
content: It reads everything from the big end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
context: Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. They have argued
about it for a very long time.

daemons.name: TRANSFER
content: It grows fruit in one land and carries
it to the next, where the young ones
already know how to eat it.
context: What it learned far away is still good
here. That is why it travels.

daemons.name: OVERTONE
content: It rings one note, and each listener
hears something different in it,
depending on where they stand.
context: The note never changes. The people
who hear it do.

daemons.name: REDACTED
content: It appears before a disaster. It knows
what is coming, and every word of the
warning is blacked out.
context: People blame it for what comes next.
It only came to tell them.

daemons.name: LOCKFILE
content: It sits in front of a door and will not
move, and while it sits there nothing
else may touch what is inside.
context: It meant to be there for a moment.
Nobody came to let it go.

daemons.name: STALEMATE
content: It waits for something that is waiting
for it. Neither moves. The ice around
them has not moved in years.
context: Nothing is broken. Everything is
simply waiting for everything else.
